items.text: Greet visitors; check bookings. Give walk-ins numbered cards only if a bench is available: a queue marker, not a repair or bench promise. When Friday’s printout is missing at 9:15, the host checks the live shared tablet list before assigning cards; never substitute last month’s printout. The host may verify names and bookings, cannot approve repairs or promise a bench. With no host, pause card distribution and phone the coordinator.
